summary.text: Anthony Merante is a certified public accountant and former Yonkers City Councilmember (6th District, two terms) running for New York State Senate District 35 on the Republican line against Majority Leader Andrea Stewart-Cousins. He announced a run for mayor of Yonkers in 2023. His campaign website presents him as a taxpayer advocate with a career in accounting and tax services.

paragraphs.text: Holds a B.S. in Accounting from St. John's University (1982) and became a Certified Public Accountant in 1987; according to his campaign website, he has been a member of the New York State Society of CPAs since 1988.
Worked in accounting, tax services and executive roles for small and mid-sized companies in the Yonkers and Westchester County region.
Served as president of the Sprain Lake Knolls Civic Association before being elected to the Yonkers City Council for the 6th District in 2017, completing two terms.
Announced in January 2023 that he would run for mayor of Yonkers, described by News 12 as the first Republican to enter that year's race.
His campaign website says he is married to Yolanda Merante and that they have two children who attended Yonkers public schools.
